Class TelemetryEvaluationContext

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.telemetry.TelemetryEvaluationContext
public final class TelemetryEvaluationContext extends Object

Telemetry Evaluation Context

Immutable per-tick physical and demographic observables context aggregated across simulation meshes, polities, and agent SoA arrays. Passed cleanly to memoized DAG evaluators.

1.0.0-beta.3
